facts.fact: The article states Madagascar created a national cybersecurity body in 2023, and quotes the head of the digital incident response team at the Computer Incident Response Team (CIRT).

note: Strategy drafting only launched; no adopted strategy stated.

facts.fact: Minister Delmotte says laws were enacted to create an official national body, the CIRT (Computer Incident Response Team), which the ministry is piloting this year.
L'Express de Madagascar quotes the director general of the Computer Incident Response Team Madagascar (CIRT-MG), which it says has begun joining the SADC CIRT and Africa CIRT networks.

note: Only an early draft strategy exists and the CIRT is planned, not created.
